description: Catalog of country-level coverage: id, OpenAQ country code, name, the date span of available station data (datetimeFirst/datetimeLast), and which parameters are measured anywhere in that country. The availability check before a regional sweep — answers "which countries have NO2 monitoring?" and tells you whether a country has recent data before you call openaq_find_locations. Coverage is uneven worldwide; this surfaces where measured data exists. Results come a page at a time (20 countries by default); totalCount is the full filtered count.

limit.description: Max countries to return (1–100). Default 20. Applied after query and parametersId, in OpenAQ catalog order.

page.description: Which page of the filtered list to return (1-based). Default 1. With limit 20, page 2 returns countries 21–40. A page past the last one returns no countries and a notice naming the last page.

parametersId.description: Only return countries that measure this parameter id somewhere (e.g. 2 = PM2.5 µg/m³) — the one-call answer to "which countries have NO2 monitoring?". Get ids from openaq_list_parameters; the same pollutant has several ids for different units. Composes with query.

query.description: Case-insensitive filter over the country catalog by code and name. A two-letter query matches an exact ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code first (e.g. "US" → United States) and falls back to substrings when no code matches; longer queries match as substrings (e.g. "united", "germany"). Omit to page through the whole catalog.

name: openaq_list_countries

items.description: A country with its coverage span and measured parameters

code.description: OpenAQ country code: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, or "-99" where OpenAQ has none — pass as iso to openaq_find_locations

datetimeFirst.description: UTC timestamp of the earliest available measurement in this country (ISO 8601)

datetimeLast.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent measurement — recent means the country has live coverage

parameters.description: Parameters measured anywhere in this country — a coverage hint, not a per-station guarantee

items.description: A parameter measured somewhere in this country

id.description: Parameter id measured somewhere in this country

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_error`: OpenAQ /countries returned 5xx or an unreadable body on every retry. `rate_limited`: OpenAQ returned 429 — the request budget for this key is exhausted. `upstream_timeout`: OpenAQ /countries did not respond within the request timeout on every retry. `invalid_api_key`: OpenAQ returned 401 — the configured OPENAQ_API_KEY is missing, invalid, or revoked. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when the filters matched nothing, when more pages follow (the next page to request), or when the page is past the last one.

shown.description: Number of countries returned on this page.

totalCount.description: Countries matched after query and parametersId, across every page.

truncated.description: True when more matching countries follow on later pages.

title: openaq-mcp-server: list countries
